description: This source file defines the `SessionActions` enum with static functions to manage sessions, display alerts, and open session logs within a macOS application.

methods.name: patchSession
methods.description: Asynchronously patches a session with optional thinking and verbose levels by sending a request via ControlChannel.

methods.name: resetSession
methods.description: Asynchronously resets a session identified by its key.

methods.name: deleteSession
methods.description: Asynchronously deletes a session and its transcript by key.

methods.name: compactSession
methods.description: Asynchronously compacts a session, limiting the transcript to a maximum number of lines.

methods.name: confirmDestructiveAction
methods.description: Displays a confirmation alert for potentially destructive actions and returns true if confirmed.

methods.name: presentError
methods.description: Displays an error alert with a given title and error message.

methods.name: openSessionLogInCode
methods.description: Attempts to open a session log file in the default code editor or file viewer, falling back to activating the file in the Finder if needed.
